notes.title: Patch note - Update 1.2 "Wrecked"
notes.content:
We are sorry that this update took so long for us, but unfortunately we had quite few bugs as we added Easy Anti-cheat and overhauled more than half of our codebase. However we are happy to announce that the new update 1.2 "Wrecked" is here with new content and requested features! See below the added content & bug fixes.

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]New map: Wrecked, crashed plane on a deserted island
[*]New weapon: Pistol, move quickly and fire rapidly
[*]New gamemode: Scavenger, ammo is limited and you must collect more from dead enemies/allies
[*]New gamemode: Secure & Survive, round based gamemode where you must secure the cargo drop or eliminate enemy team
[*]5 new challenges that will give you a total of 10 new cosmetics
[*]Possibility to play without Epic account. It's still possible to link the accounts if you want to.
[*]Teammate spectate mechanic for Secure & Survive gamemode
[*]Added spawn protection
[*]Added Easy Anti-cheat
[*]Added player reporting
[*]Better host migration, now it syncs all your data from previous session
[*]Map vote has now random gamemodes tied to votable maps, but first map will have the current gamemode
[*]Added loading screen after splash screen, now The Riflemen launch faster
[*]Optimized file sizes, now it uses 70% less storage space
[*]Optimized ram usage
[*]Grenades now have short line behind them when thrown
[*]Barrels & landmines can now be exploded with melee weapons
[*]Supply drops now show the weapon that will be received
[*]New background scenery on main menu
[*]New theme music
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]All maps now have correct navmeshes for bots
[*]Fixed match end music not starting always
[*]Sniper scope texture flipped correctly when playing as left handed
[*]Plus many more smaller fixes..
[/list]

[b]Known bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*]Canceling Epic Games & Steam accounts linking procedure from main menu will not allow you to relink until restart of The Riflemen
[*]High GPU usage because The Riflemen runs on uncapped frame rate
[*]Map vote won't sometimes sync the votable maps
[*]Vsync toggle won't always work
[*]Splash screen & loading screen can take some time to finish loading
[/list]

See you on the battlefields!

notes.title: Update Alert: Dive Into the Mines for Explosive Action! 🚀💥
notes.content:
The wait is over, and it's time to dive back into the heart-pounding world of The Riflemen. We've been toiling away in the shadows, and now we're thrilled to unveil our most explosive update yet: Mines! And mines!

🌟 Embark on an Underground Adventure 🌟
Picture this: the claustrophobic, dark corridors of our brand-new map, Mines. Each step echoes in the underground labyrinth, a perfect setting for ambushes. Navigate carefully, as danger lurks around every corner. The landmine, our latest deadly addition, is your best friend in these tight spaces. Find it in supply drops and lay your traps to catch your enemies off-guard. Boom! Victory is sweeter when it's unexpected.

💥 Gold Rush: A Frenzy of Fortune 💥
In the midst of chaos, there's a chance to strike gold. Literally. Our new mode, "Gold Rush", isn't just about shooting - it's a mad dash to collect gold from fallen comrades and foes alike. Sprint to the depot, deposit your loot, and feel the rush of being on top. It's not just a game; it's a gold heist with guns!

🏅 A Journey of Growth and Rewards 🏅
As you rise through the ranks, every 10th level marks a milestone, rewarding you with exclusive cosmetics. Your soldier’s journey is now more rewarding than ever, with challenges that promise not just glory, but also style. And for our dedicated premium players, we've got something extra special. You are the champions who keep the battlefield alive, and your presence now brings an XP bonus for everyone in the game. A true leader lifts others, and in The Riflemen, everyone gets stronger together.

🔄 Revamped, Refined, Reimagined 🔄
It's not just about new additions; it's about making the good even better. We've tweaked our supply drops to keep the arsenal fresh, highlighted your achievements on the leaderboard with a golden touch, and made progress tracking a breeze with new post-match bars. Your feedback has been our guiding star, leading to refined animations, smarter bots that know how to dodge a bullet, and even lush trees in the Overpass map for that extra cover.

🎧 Hear the Battle Roar 🎧
And let’s not forget the sounds of war - from the unique audio cues as you equip new skins to the revamped announcer adding spice to your medal achievements. Every element has been tuned to make your battlefield experience as immersive as it gets.

So, gear up, Riflemen! Dive into Mines, feel the rush of Gold Rush, and embrace the thrill of new challenges. Your journey in The Riflemen just got a whole lot more exciting. We're in this together, and together, we'll redefine the art of virtual warfare.

Stay sharp, stay lethal, and most importantly, enjoy the adventure!

🔥 #RiflemenMines #BattleReady #NewAdventures 🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022330/The_Riflemen/

notes.title: Patch note 1.1 - Content update
notes.content:
It’s been a while since the last update was released but worry not, we have been cooking something bigger all this time. With this update named themedly “Mines” comes a lot of new and fixes to old.

[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*]Mines, a new map where you fight in tight spaces underground.
[*]Landmine weapon. Get this new explosive from the supply drops in game and surprise your 
enemies!
[*]Gold Rush gamemode. Collect gold drops from enemies and your allies and deposit those on the 
depot point to gain score.
[*]Challenges. These lifetime missions grant new exclusive cosmetics for everyone! There are also a 
few bonus rewards for our loyal premium players.
[*]Free cosmetics when leveling up your soldier. Every 10th level rewards you with a new cosmetic.
[*]XP bonus from premium players. Every premium player in a match grant additional xp bonus 
of 5%. In total this can get up to 50%!
[*]New daily & weekly missions to grind.
[/list]

[b]What has been changed?[/b]
[list]
[*]Supply drops. With a new weapon to get we changed it so that you can’t get the same weapon 
twice in a row from supply drops.
[*]Leaderboard. Your own name will be highlighted and each premium player has golden outlines on 
their names.
[*]Progress bar. Now after you complete a match you will see how much xp is needed for the next level.
[*]Announcer. We added more variety to existing clips and now some of the medals will have 
announcer cheering you up!
[*]Medals. We added 3 new medals to grind. There are now “Killing spree” for getting 5 kills without 
dying and “Unstoppable” for getting 10 kills without dying. For Gold Rush game mode there is a 
“Gold deposited” medal.
[*]Gamemode balancing. Now kills grant 50 points in Domination & Gold Rush gamemodes so players need focus more on the objectives.
[*]Customization. Now it’s possible to inspect cosmetics by hovering cursor over them. Equipping skins 
also have unique sound attached to them.
[*]A lot of UI animations & improvements.
[*]Tweaked first person view model walk animation.
[*]Now there's a animation when players take damage.
[*]Bots AI have been improved. They have now different behaviour so sometimes they will strafe and try to dodge enemy fire. Also the bug has been fixed where bots freezed on air.
[*]Chat. There is now a join message when player joins the battlefield.
[*]In game menu. Password is now hidden by default. If you want you can show it with a press of a button.
[*]Small changes to Overrun & Overpass maps.
[/list]

We hope to see you on the battlefields collecting some gold!

notes.title: Why Do You Need an Epic Account to Play on Steam?
notes.content:
We have received some reviews from players who disliked the need for an Epic Account to play The Riflemen. The game indeed uses Epic Online Services to handle multiplayer features. Here is some clarification on why we decided to go with this solution. 

[b]No Extra Costs for You or Us
[/b]As a small indie game studio, we can't afford big server bills. This is the only free solution that there is. This, in turn, enables us to offer The Riflemen as a freemium game, as opposed to a free-to-play model that relies on monthly battle passes and in-game purchases to cover server expenses. Server costs are reason why indie-multiplayer games often dies.

[b]Keep Playing, No Matter What
[/b]Even if we don't make much money from game sales, multiplayer won't disappear. We can maintain the game's multiplayer without relying on sales alone. (No server costs)

[b]Connect Your Progress
[/b]With an Epic Account, your game progress carries across different platforms. That’s your Costumes, Skins, Dogtags, etc.

[b]To Play Together on Different Platforms
[/b]We use Epic Online Services to make sure you can play The Riflemen with your friends no matter on what platform you are. On Steam, Epic, Playstation, and Xbox. 

We hope this sheds some light on the matter why EOS. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022330/The_Riflemen/

notes.title: Bonus Stage & The Riflemen: Full Release Coming in 2023
notes.content:
[i]Bonus Stage, the beloved indie publisher, is thrilled to announce the release of "The Riflemen," set to launch on Steam and other stores on PC in 2023.[/i]

"The Riflemen" takes players on action-packed 5v5 multiplayer combats through different maps designed in WW2 style. Players will step into the boots of an expert marksman, hunting for enemies, protecting their allies, and trying to win the high-stakes battles, while mastering the art of bolt-action rifle shooting. With an extensive arsenal of historically inspired firearms dropping during the matches, players will face off against formidable foes in stunningly realized environments and physics.

[previewyoutube=EVmLaCGccCs;full][/previewyoutube]

"The Riflemen" delivers an engaging multiplayer experience, offering a variety of game modes that cater to both casual and competitive players. With an extensive ranking system, customizable characters, and a thriving community, players will be able to test their skills against others from around the globe.

The Riflemen will include unique weapon skins, character outfits, and a lot more to come. Gamers can join the growing community by joining the game's Discord server, where they can engage with fellow fans, share gameplay tips, and stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates.

"The Riflemen" is poised to set a new benchmark for the FPS genre, and Bonus Stage is eager to share this immersive experience with gamers worldwide. Prepare to take aim and make your mark when "The Riflemen" launches on Steam in 2023!
